title: Write a custom shader with uniforms
summary: Start with a UV gradient and add aligned uniform data to control a procedural surface.
outcome: An animated shader surface with editable colors and correctly aligned parameter data.

blocks.text: The first surface uses only UV coordinates. Then a uniform buffer controls a ring pattern, two colors and elapsed time. Click the complete surface to freeze time.

Shader installs quad geometry, ShaderFragment and MeshRenderer. Your fragment body assigns finalColor. input.uv ranges over the surface; view.time contains scene milliseconds (divide by 1000 for seconds) and view.size contains viewport pixels. userFunctions supplies module-scope structs and helpers. See [Shader](/api-entities-primitives-2d#shader).

UniformSchema calculates byte offsets and padding. A vec4 following a vec2 does not simply follow it in a dense float array. UniformBufferData writes fields by name. It writes floating-point data; integer fields need an appropriate integer typed view.

The resource setter generates the binding for the name palette. Keep that name identical in WGSL. Updating buffer values reuses the pipeline. Changing the declaration or resource layout is a different operation and can rebuild shaders.
4. Run and inspect the complete surface

BufferOwner releases the allocation through Renderer.destroyBuffers. Shader.setUniformBuffer binds an existing buffer and does not assume ownership. For textures and samplers, use [Shader.setTexture and setSampler](/api-entities-primitives-2d#shader) and follow [shader resources](/shader-system).

The camera updater keeps the known 6 × 4 surface dimensions visible at different preview aspect ratios. The pause control uses Scene.setEvent and tests its world coordinates against that rectangle; it does not depend on Shader picking bounds.

items: Change uniform colors without editing the WGSL.
Compare a change to the numeric time value with a change to the shader frequency constant.

blocks.text: Check the result: The surface should animate and freeze on click. A binding or struct error appears in the example console; verify names, declarations and byte layout before expanding the shader.
Continue with [Use ComputeKernel](/tutorial-compute-kernel). Use the [tutorial index](/tutorials) to choose another project.
